meta.name: Send weekly blended ad performance reports with Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4 and OpenAI

parameters.content:
## 📊 Automated Client Ad Reporting

Every Monday at 8am, this workflow fetches spend and performance metrics from Meta and Google Ads APIs, blends them with GA4 conversion data, generates an AI-powered summary of key insights, and automatically delivers a branded HTML report to the client via email and posts a summary to your internal Slack channel.

**Perfect for:** Agency media buyers, account managers, and client success teams automating weekly performance reports.

---

## How it works

1. **Every Monday 8am** — Triggers the workflow on a weekly schedule.
2. **Fetch Meta Ads Insights** — Queries the Meta Ads API for spend, impressions, clicks, and actions from the past 7 days.
3. **Fetch Google Ads Report** — Queries the Google Ads API for campaign names, cost, clicks, and conversions from the past 7 days.
4. **Fetch GA4 Conversions** — Queries the GA4 Reporting API for conversion counts and revenue by channel from the past 7 days.
5. **Blend Data Sources** — Combines the three data streams into a single merged object.
6. **Compute Blended Metrics** — Calculates total spend, total conversions, total revenue, and blended ROAS across all platforms.
7. **Summarize What Moved (AI Agent)** — Uses an AI model to analyze the metrics and generate a plain-language summary of key insights.
8. **OpenAI Chat Model** — Language model that powers the AI analysis in the previous step.
9. **Build Report** — Assembles the computed metrics and AI summary into an HTML report template.
10. **Email Report to Client** — Sends the formatted HTML report to the client's email address.
11. **Post to Agency Channel** — Posts a brief performance summary to your internal Slack channel.
12. **Error Trigger** — *(optional path)* Detects if the main workflow fails at any point.
13. **Notify Ops** — *(optional path)* Alerts your ops team in Slack if an error occurs.

---

## Setup (~20 minutes)

1. **Meta Ads API** — Add your API token in the *Fetch Meta Ads Insights* node. Replace `YOUR_AD_ACCOUNT` with your actual account ID.
2. **Google Ads API** — Add your OAuth credentials in the *Fetch Google Ads Report* node. Replace `YOUR_CUSTOMER_ID` with your account ID.
3. **GA4 API** — Add your OAuth credentials in the *Fetch GA4 Conversions* node. Replace `YOUR_GA4_PROPERTY_ID` with your property ID.
4. **OpenAI API** — Add your API key in the *OpenAI Chat Model* node for the AI summary analysis.
5. **Gmail** — Authenticate in the *Email Report to Client* node and set the recipient email address.
6. **Slack** — Authenticate in both *Post to Agency Channel* and *Notify Ops* nodes, then set your channel IDs.

> This workflow sends live API calls every Monday. If you need custom date ranges or additional metrics, edit the query parameters in the fetch nodes before activating.

## 1️⃣ Trigger & Data Intake

The **Every Monday 8am** trigger fires the workflow every Monday at 8am UTC. Three HTTP requests execute in parallel: **Fetch Meta Ads Insights** pulls spend and engagement metrics from your Meta ad account, **Fetch Google Ads Report** retrieves campaign performance and costs from Google Ads, and **Fetch GA4 Conversions** queries your analytics property for conversion counts and revenue data by channel.

## 2️⃣ Data Processing & AI Analysis

The **Blend Data Sources** node merges the three data streams into one unified object. The **Compute Blended Metrics** code node then calculates critical KPIs: total spend across both platforms, combined conversion count, total revenue, and blended ROAS. The **Summarize What Moved (AI Agent)** node passes all computed metrics to the **OpenAI Chat Model**, which generates a concise, plain-language analysis of performance trends, standout metrics, risks, and one actionable recommendation suitable for client consumption.

## 3️⃣ Report Assembly & Delivery

The **Build Report** node takes the computed metrics and AI summary and renders them into a formatted HTML report with client-friendly styling and the week's key numbers prominently displayed. The **Email Report to Client** node then sends this HTML report directly to your client's inbox with a timestamped subject line. Simultaneously, the **Post to Agency Channel** node posts a quick Slack summary to your internal team channel so the account manager and agency leadership stay in the loop.

## 4️⃣ Error Handling

If the main workflow fails at any step, the **Error Trigger** catches the failure and passes it to the **Notify Ops** node, which immediately posts an alert to your ops Slack channel with the error message so your team can investigate before the client notices a missing report.
